main_text.p: Iancholicos,& similia speculationis impedimenta. 5Libidinis impetum extinguit, & tentationes atq; stimulos carnis mi-rifice sedat, magnamq; carni ac spiritui tranquillitatem conciliat. Sobrietas enim sensim minuit copiam spermatis, copiam item & feruorem spirituum: quibus imminutis sponte 5 cessant libidinosæ imaginationes. Atque hæc sunt eximia illa commoda sanctæ sobrietatis, cuius studiosi cultores illa abundè sunt experti, puta Elias, Elisæus, Daniel, Democritus, Hippocrates, Iohannes Baptista, Bartholus, Cornarus, & alij, de quibus vide Hygiasticon Leonhardi Lessij, scriptum diuinum, ex quo hanc commentationem desumsimus. 10Tu, homo Dei, ad animum revoca hanc sive commentationem sive commendationem sanctæ sobrietatis, & singulis momentis meditare illud Christi Luc.21.v.34. Attendite vobis ipsis, ne forte grauentur corda vestra crapula & ebrietate, & curæ huius vitæ, & repente in vos superueniat dies ille. Item illud Petri 1.epist.c.5.v.8. Sobrij estote, vigilate: aduersarius vester diabolus, tanquam leo rugiens circuit, quærens quem deuoret: cui resistite, fortes in fide. 15VII. Institutio medica præscribit rationem 20diætæ & varia medicamenta, quibus sanitas defenditur, & recuperatur. Huius loci sunt præcepta de aëre ambiente, de esculentis & potulentis, de retentione & euacuatione, de variis exercitiis corporis, de 25somno atque vigilia, de animi perturbationibus, de refectione & confortatione cerebri, cordis, &c. quæ peti possunt è libellis medicis. Sed iis nihil opus est, si nostra monita seruies. Summa enim huc redit:

p.i: Si tibi deficiant medici, medici tibi fiant
Hæc tria: Mens hilaris, Requies, Moderata diæta.

main_text.p: VIII. Ad hygiasticam sacram pertinet illa quæstio, Cur Deus Leuit. 11. & Deut. 14. prohibuerit certos cibos, alios vero concesserit. Varij varia hic adferunt. Et primo quidem Porphyrius, apostata, 35dixit excessum aut defectum caloris aut humoris radicalis

page.notes: The right-margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line markers as printed. The "5" beside "sponte" and the "5" at the first line were both read as printed. The word "Va-rij" is split across the line end; the "Va-" and "rij" are joined here as the same word. The final word "dicalis" is partly blurred at the right edge. "copiam" after "spermatis" is doubtful. The Lessij spelling is read from a ligature and may be "Lesßij". The headings "VII." and "VIII." are set in larger type but as run-in lines, so they are kept as paragraphs.
